name: amfx-japan-us-10y-divergence-research
description: amFX reproduction (29MAY24 p4): Japan 10-year JGB yield vs US 10-year Treasury yield Jul 2023 to May 2024. The 'Widowmaker No More' thesis — JGB yields breaking out to multi-year highs while US yields remain below 2023 peaks. The divergence suggests Team Japan (GPIF, Kampo) may rotate back to JGBs, significant for global bond flows. US 10Y from FRED DGS10 (daily), Japan 10Y from FRED IRLTLT01JPM156N (monthly, ffilled).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: Japan 10Y vs US 10Y Yield (29MAY24 p4)
# =============================================================================
# "Widowmaker No More" — JGB yields breaking out to multi-year highs
# while US yields remain below 2023 peaks. From ~Nov 2023 onward,
# US yields decline while Japan yields accelerate higher.
#
# US 10Y: FRED DGS10 (daily, ~3.6%-5.1%)
# Japan 10Y: FRED IRLTLT01JPM156N (monthly, ffilled, ~0.3%-1.1%)
# =============================================================================

# US 10-Year Treasury Yield (daily via common indicators)
us10y_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
us10y = ffill(us10y_src.result)

# Japan 10-Year JGB Yield (monthly, forward-filled to daily)
jp10y_src = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01JPM156N')()
jp10y = ffill(jp10y_src.result)

idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: US 10Y and Japan 10Y Overlay
# =============================================================================
# Since these have very different scales (US ~3.6-5.1%, JP ~0.3-1.1%),
# we plot them as separate series. EpochScript xy_lines uses a single y-axis,
# so we display both yields on the same scale.
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Japan 10Y vs US 10Y: Widowmaker No More?',
    category='Yield Divergence',
    y_axis_label='Yield (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 10-Year Yield', color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Japan 10-Year Yield', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(us10y, jp10y))
